fullDesc: The 250 Ohm 5W ceramic cement power resistor is a wire-wound resistor sealed in a white ceramic cement body. fullDesc: The IR2103S is a half-bridge MOSFET and IGBT gate driver IC in an 8-pin SMD (SOIC-8) package. Key Features ⚡ 600V high-side floating channel – drives the top MOSFET of a half-bridge using bootstrap operation, no isolated supply needed. 🔧 10–20V gate drive supply – suits standard MOSFETs and IGBTs. ✅ 3.3V, 5V and 15V logic compatible – works straight from microcontroller pins. 🛡️ Built-in shoot-through protection – cross-conduction prevention logic and an internal dead time of about 520 ns stop both switches turning on together. 🔋 Undervoltage lockout – outputs switch off if VCC falls below about 8.2V, protecting MOSFETs from weak gate drive. 📏 SMD SOIC-8 package – small footprint for compact, machine-assembled boards. 🔁 dV/dt immune and tolerant to negative transients on the VS pin. fullDesc: Description: This is a desoldering braid (also known as solder wick), a fine, flat braided copper wire used to remove unwanted or excess solder from PCBs and electronic components during rework, repair, or component replacement. When heated with a soldering iron while pressed against a solder joint, the braid's tightly woven copper strands draw up the molten solder through capillary action, effectively lifting it off the board — making it an essential tool for desoldering through-hole components, cleaning up solder bridges, and general circuit board rework. The braid is treated with a rosin flux coating, which helps the copper wick more effectively absorb solder by improving wetting and reducing oxidation during the desoldering process. This particular reel offers a 3.0mm width, a versatile middle-ground size suitable for a wide range of common desoldering tasks — wide enough to lift solder efficiently from standard through-hole joints and pads, while still being manageable for more detailed work. Packaged on a compact plastic spool with a clear label, the 1.5-meter length provides ample braid for multiple desoldering sessions before needing replacement, making it a practical addition to any electronics repair toolkit, workbench, or soldering station. fullDesc: Product Description The TS25PF07G Power Semiconductor Module is a compact high-power electronic component designed for use in power switching, control, and conversion circuits. It features a rugged molded package with four external terminals and mounting holes for secure installation on a PCB, heatsink, or suitable mounting surface. Its robust construction makes it suitable for various power electronics, industrial control, switching, and electrical conversion applications . The component should be used according to the manufacturer's electrical specifications and terminal configuration Component Identification Marking on Device: TS25P07G, SHS, S1D4 Manufacturer: Taiwan Semiconductor Corporation (TSC) Device Type: Single-Phase, Full-Wave Bridge Rectifier Package: TS-6P / SIP-4P (4-Pin, Through Hole, with center mounting hole) Pin Configuration (left to right, as marked on body): Pin Symbol Function 1 + DC Output (Positive) 2 ~ AC Input 3 ~ AC Input 4 − DC Output (Negative) What This Component Does This device converts an AC (alternating current) input into a pulsating DC (direct current) output. fullDesc: Description: The SN74HC75N contains four independent bistable (transparent) latches, commonly used for temporarily storing binary data between processing stages, such as between a microcontroller/CPU and an input/output or display device. Two latches are controlled together by one of two active-HIGH enable inputs (LE12 and LE34). While the enable (LE) input is HIGH, data present at the D input passes straight through to the Q output — the latch is "transparent." When the enable input goes LOW, the last data value present just before the transition is captured and held stable at the output, regardless of further changes on the D input, until the enable goes HIGH again. fullDesc: Description: This is a 3.7V, 350mAh Lithium Polymer (LiPo) rechargeable battery, designed to provide lightweight, high-density power for small electronic devices. LiPo cells like this one are widely favored in compact applications due to their excellent energy-to-weight ratio, stable discharge performance, and slim, flexible pouch-style construction, which allows them to fit easily into tight enclosures where a rigid cylindrical cell wouldn't work. The battery is housed in a soft, foil-wrapped pouch cell format, with a distinctive ribbed surface pattern that helps manage internal gas expansion and adds a degree of physical protection to the cell during normal handling. It outputs a nominal voltage of 3.7V, standard for a single-cell (1S) LiPo battery, and offers a capacity of 350mAh — suitable for powering small, low-current devices for a reasonable runtime between charges. Wiring is terminated in a small 2-pin JST-style connector (white housing), a common standard connector used across many hobbyist and small-device applications, allowing for simple plug-and-play connection to a compatible charger or device without needing to solder wires directly. Key Specifications: Battery Type: Lithium Polymer (LiPo), Rechargeable Nominal Voltage: 3.7V (1S configuration) Capacity: 350mAh Connector Type: 2-Pin JST Connector Cell Format: Soft Pouch Cell Applications: Mini RC drones and quadcopters, small RC toys and vehicles, wearable electronics, Bluetooth devices, small robotics projects, and other compact, lightweight electronic devices requiring a small rechargeable power source. Important Safety Note: LiPo batteries require careful handling — always charge using a charger specifically designed for LiPo cells, avoid puncturing or physically damaging the pouch, avoid over-discharging or overcharging, and store at a safe partial charge level when not in use for extended periods. fullDesc: Description: The CMA31-C is a heavy-duty automotive relay manufactured by HKE (Zhejiang HKE), designed to switch high-current electrical loads in vehicles and other 12V DC systems using a low-power control signal. It operates as an electromagnetic relay with a 12V DC coil, allowing a small trigger current (from a switch, sensor, or control module) to safely energize and switch a much larger load current — a fundamental building block in automotive wiring, aftermarket electronics, and 12V power control circuits. Built with an SPDT (Single Pole, Double Throw / 1 Form C) contact configuration, this relay provides both normally-open and normally-closed switching paths from a single common terminal, making it versatile for a range of switching applications including headlights, fans, horns, fuel pumps, lighting circuits, and other accessory loads. The contacts are rated for up to 30A at 14VDC, giving it enough switching capacity to handle demanding automotive and industrial loads reliably. The relay features a compact, fully sealed plastic housing that protects the internal contacts and coil from dust, moisture, and vibration — an important consideration in the harsh, high-vibration environment of a vehicle engine bay or chassis. It includes a metal mounting bracket with a bolt-hole, allowing it to be securely fastened to a vehicle body panel, relay box, or DIN rail bracket, along with standard male spade (quick-connect) terminals for simple, tool-free wiring connections. Key Specifications: Manufacturer: HKE (Zhejiang HKE) Part Number: CMA31-C Coil Voltage: DC 12V Contact Configuration: SPDT / 1 Form C (Change-over) Contact Rating: 30A @ 14VDC Contact Material: Silver Alloy Dielectric Strength: 500VAC (1 minute) Electrical Life: 100,000 operations Operating Temperature Range: -40°C to +85°C Mounting Type: Bracket Mount (bolt-hole tab) Terminal Type: Quick-connect spade terminals Applications: Automotive accessory switching (lights, horns, fans, fuel pumps), power window and central locking systems, motor control circuits, aftermarket 12V electronics, marine and RV wiring, and general-purpose high-current DC switching applications. fullDesc: Description: The ZH-CR75-8 is a full-color LED display receiving card, a core control component used inside LED video wall cabinets to receive, process, and distribute video/image data to the LED modules that make up the display. It works alongside a corresponding sending card (installed in a control PC or video processor) to form a complete LED display control system, translating incoming video signals into the precise pixel-level output required to drive the LED matrix in real time. At the heart of the board is an Altera Cyclone IV FPGA (EP4CE6F17C8N) , which provides the processing power needed to handle real-time video data distribution, pixel mapping, and display timing with low latency — critical for smooth, flicker-free LED video playback. The board also includes a Winbond serial flash memory chip (W9864G2IH-5 series) for firmware and configuration storage, along with an SGM4800 series component supporting the board's power and signal management functions. The card features eight HUB75-style IDC ribbon cable output ports (organized in JP1–JP8 connector groups), allowing it to drive multiple LED module chains directly from a single card — a hallmark of "wide" or high-port-count receiving cards designed for larger or more complex LED cabinet configurations. It also includes an RJ45 Ethernet-style port for receiving incoming video data from the sending card or network-based control system, and a set of screw-terminal power inputs for connecting the board to the LED display's DC power supply. This type of receiving card is typically installed inside LED display cabinets (indoor or outdoor video walls, advertising screens, stage backdrops, and similar large-format LED installations) and is responsible for ensuring accurate, synchronized image reproduction across the entire display surface.
